Message Types

e CreditAgencyReportERPDebtRecoveryScoreByDebtorPartyQuery

Notes on SAP Implementation

Processing

You need to activate the use of the debt recovery score in Customizing of Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under
Business Transactions -> Submit to Collection Agency -> Define Specifications for Debt Recovery Score.

Enhancements

You can enhance this service operation by using the event concept in Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable. In event 6252,
you can fill customer-specific fields in the outbound message used to request the debt recovery score. These fields are included in
the message type using a data type enhancement.

Manage Contract Account In

Definition

Request to and confirmation from contract account for provision of contract account data.

Technical Data

Entity Type               Service Interface
Category                  SAP A2A
Direction         inbound

Business Context and Use

The inbound service interface Manage Contract Account In groups operations that read information from the system which is

relevant for the contract account.

Change Contract Account based Credit Worthiness Change
Information

Definition

To receive information about a change to a debtor's creditworthiness.

Technical Data
